title: Setup: a tenant setting for person-name order (follow the language / always family first / always given first), on top of the personName declaration
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

## Source

Split off objectstack#32677 by the HotCRM maintainer's ruling (2026-11-12T10:10Z, option A, in the HotCRM decision thread), at **p3**. Analysis: https://claude.ai/artifact/Cq5s9nCJzMiWsRbxqupExT

## What

A tenant-level setting in Setup that overrides the CLDR `nameOrder` that #32677 uses for input order. It has three values:
- **跟语言**: follow the language. This is the default.
- **总是姓前**: always family name first.
- **总是名前**: always given name first.

## Depends on

objectstack#32677, the `personName` declaration and locale-based input order.
